title: Pod Salt Fusion Peanut Butter Banana Granola  Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Peanut Butter Banana Granola by Yogi is a delicious breakfast snack comprising freshly baked oats mixed with creamy banana chunks finished off with delicious peanut butter. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
